name: Apple Mac Tools
tagline: Mac-only installer that sets up tested Mac command-line tools so your Grok Bots can use Apple apps.
description: Mac-only installer that sets up tested Mac command-line tools so your Grok Bots can use Apple apps. It greets you with every tool grouped by permission (iMessages, not Messages), offers Install all / Pick by group / Let me pick (five permission-grouped step boxes, up to 5 tools each plus None from this group), lets you type back to redo the last box, then installs, verifies, opens the right Privacy & Security panes, and sends a summary. It never asks for your password, never uses sudo or the Keychain, never reads your data, and never installs anything you didn't pick.
author: Kevin_Logan
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
